uncertainty.method: Large-sample Bonferroni intervals for both absolute means and the paired change per field. Six seats and all fixed training seeds are averaged inside the original card. Group bounds propagate these simultaneous intervals and allow arbitrary field correlation.

primary.scope: Conditional on the fixed policies, training seeds, and declared opponent lineups. Weights are equal across families and equal within family. Saturation applies to each lineup mean before weighting. The holdout has its own cards and separate summary.
